paragraphs.text: General Jarkeld , known as the "Arctic Fox" for his tactical brilliance, was a military commander for Kjeldor during Dominaria 's Ice Age .

Jarkeld is counted as one of the most storied generals of Kjeldor . His battallion was trained by Fyndhorn Elves , and even the Balduvians he fought respected him for his faith in his troops. Jarkeld was slain when his men lost a battle in the Adarkar Wastes . By 2934, the saga of his lost order had become a written volume found in the Royal Academy of Magic in Krov .
Jodah created an illusion of him during the last battle against Lim-Dûl to boost the morale of the Kjeldorans.
